But consciousness does seem to imply that we need some sort of paradigm shift, as it is not explainable within our current model of the universe. Until we see what happens at the other side of that paradigm shift, I'm reluctant to commit completely to materialism.

It's as if we're building a huge jigsaw - all the materialist pieces fit, and the picture of the universe we're getting is beautiful. We're down to the very last piece of the jigsaw, which happens to be consciousness. Except the last piece won't fit. No matter which way we turn it around, it won't fit. Because it's a banana.

Until someone smarter than me explains what the hell is going on with that jigsaw, I'm not comfortable ruling anything out regarding that missing piece (although of course some explanations I consider more likely than others).
